all.source_quote: Age should be between18 and 40 years at the time of enrollment.

unmodelled.text: Must be an unorganised-sector worker (street vendor, construction worker, domestic worker, etc.)
unmodelled.source_quote: Must be an unorganized sector worker (e.g., street vendors, construction workers, domestic workers, etc.).

unmodelled.text: Own monthly income must be Rs 15,000 or less (the app asks family income per year, so this is not checked)
unmodelled.source_quote: Monthly income should be Rs 15,000 or less.

unmodelled.text: Must have an Aadhaar number linked to a mobile number
unmodelled.source_quote: Must possess a valid Aadhaar number linked with a mobile number.

unmodelled.text: Must have a savings bank or Jan Dhan account
unmodelled.source_quote: Should have anactive savings bank account or Jan Ohan account.

unmodelled.text: Must not be covered by EPFO, ESIC or NPS
unmodelled.source_quote: Must not be covered under any other statutory social security scheme (such as EPF0, ESIC,orNPS).
Must not be an income taxpayer.

ambiguous: Source is a short summary by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs on wb.gov.in, not the scheme's own guidelines

en.title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan
en.benefit: Pension of Rs 3,000 a month from age 60; the government matches your monthly contribution (Rs 55 to Rs 200).
en.how_to_apply: Enrol at a Common Service Centre or online with Aadhaar and bank details; set up the monthly auto-debit.
